question: The downstream speed for the boat is 100 kmph and the upstream speed is 75% of the downstream speed. Find the time taken by the boat to travel 350 km in still water.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Upstream speed = 75% of 100 = 75 kmph

Speed in still water = (Downstream speed + Upstream speed) ÷ 2

Speed in still water = (100 + 75) ÷ 2 = 175 ÷ 2 = 87.5 kmph

Time taken = Distance ÷ Speed = 350 ÷ 87.5 = 4 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 4 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Downstream Speed (Sd) = 100 kmph

Upstream Speed (Sᵤ) = 75% of Downstream Speed

Distance to travel in still water (D) = 350 km

**Formula Used:**

Speed of boat in still water (Sb) = (Sd + Sᵤ) ÷ 2

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/841fc953db89d2d705a43f0dfb6df6a6a33d4b6e36643ded29f82f4f5dbe4c56.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sᵤ = (75 ÷ 100) × 100 = 75 kmph

⇒ Sb = (100 + 75) ÷ 2

⇒ Sb = 175 ÷ 2 = 87.5 kmph

⇒ Time = 350 ÷ 87.5

⇒ Time = 4 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 4 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Downstream Speed

When the boat travels in the direction of the stream. Speed = Speed of Boat + Speed of Stream.

Upstream Speed

When the boat travels against the direction of the stream. Speed = Speed of Boat − Speed of Stream.

Speed of Stream

Calculated as half the difference between downstream and upstream speeds: Sₛ = (Sd − Sᵤ) ÷ 2.
